messages:
maria_cs: FYI Opello just uploaded a vendor questionnaire asking for DPA / SOC2 evidence + a mapping. They want a mapped response + artifacts by EOD Friday. PDF attached to the ticket.
anna_csm: Thanks — what is their renewal date? we should prioritize based on risk.
maria_cs: Renewal 2026-05-12. They mentioned procurement will escalate if we miss the window.
sarah_privacy: I can own the mapping for privacy/security Qs (PI handling, retention, subprocessors, access controls).
oliver_eng: Ill pull encryption/KMS details and confirm which model hosts are affected. @nick_sre can you help with audit log export for the last 12 months?
nick_sre: On it. Will run export and put it in the secure share. Sample command Im using:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://audit.redwood.com/export?from=2025-03-01&to=2026-03-01" -o opello_audit.zip
```
ETA ~2h.
sarah_privacy: Also need to confirm whether Legal will allow sharing the SOC2 report and scope statement directly with them. @anna_csm can you check?
anna_csm: Legal confirmed: SOC2 report can be shared under the NDA they already signed (we have NDA on file). We can send the scoped SOC2 attestation + mapping.
anna_csm: Also asked procurement if they need a specific format for the evidence (PDF vs direct links). Waiting on reply.
maria_cs: Opello asked explicitly about data residency for embeddings & backups — they want a list of regions and subprocessors.
oliver_eng: Subprocessor list is in infra inventory (https://infra.redwood.com/subprocessors). Current hosting regions for hosted: us-east-1, europe-west4, asia-southeast-1. Dedicated customers can be pinned to region via contract.
nick_sre: Export finished and uploaded to secure share: https://files.redwood.com/secure/opello/opello_audit_2156789999.zip :white_check_mark:
sarah_privacy: Draft mapping uploaded here: https://docs.redwood.com/dpa-mapping/opello-draft. I've mapped each questionnaire row to SOC2 control IDs and listed available artifacts (logs, config, policy). Please review.
anna_csm: I'll draft the customer email with plan + ETA EOD Friday and copy Legal.
maria_cs: Owners for the deliverable: sarah_privacy (mapping + SOC2 attachments), oliver_eng (encryption + residency statement), nick_sre (audit export + retention policy excerpt). Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Secure upload by nick_sre completed at 2156789999.
sarah_privacy: Incorporated engineering notes, final mapping ready and linked in the ticket.
anna_csm: Email sent to Opello with links to the mapping doc, SOC2 scope, and secure download. They acked receipt and said procurement will review tomorrow. Closing the loop here.
